details.heading: 1. Basic Overview
paragraphs: The 40ft High Cube container (40HQ/40HC) is an ISO-standard dry shipping container, ranking among the most widely used container types for international export and multimodal sea-land transportation. Compared with standard 40ft general purpose containers (40GP), it features an extra 1-foot height, delivering larger loading volume. It is fully compatible with truck transportation, ocean vessel shipping and railway freight, owning excellent universal adaptability.

details.heading: 2. Standard Dimension Parameters
items: Theoretical Volume : 76.4 CBM
Tare Weight : Approximately 4 tons
Maximum Payload : Approximately 26 tons
paragraphs: 2.1 External Dimensions : 12.192m (Length) × 2.438m (Width) × 2.896m (Height)
2.2 Internal Loading Dimensions : 12.032m (Length) × 2.352m (Width) × 2.698m (Height)
2.3 Container Door Opening Dimensions : 2.340m (Door Width) × 2.580m (Door Height)
2.4 Volume and Weight Specifications

details.heading: 3. Container Structure
items: Four Corner Castings : Standard steel corner castings are equipped at four corners of the container. They fit gantry cranes, forklifts, vessel stacking and truck fixing devices perfectly, supporting multi-layer stacking during transportation and ensuring overall structural stability without deformation.

Rear Double Doors : Sealed double rear doors are fitted with heavy-duty locking bars. The tight closure effectively blocks rainwater and seawater from entering the container and guarantees reliable waterproof performance.

Integrated Steel Frame : The integral heavy-duty steel frame features outstanding compression and impact resistance. It can withstand harsh oceanic wind and wave conditions during long-distance sea shipping and avoid structural damage or deformation.

Load-bearing Floor : Reinforced solid wood floor is installed at the bottom. It bears strong compression resistance and load capacity, supporting direct forklift loading and unloading to meet frequent cargo handling demands.

details.heading: 4. Manufacturing Materials
paragraphs: Side walls and top roof are made of hot-dip galvanized corrugated steel plates , which possess superior anti-rust and anti-corrosion performance as well as strong salt spray resistance, adapting to high-humidity and high-salinity harsh marine environments. The door frame adopts thickened alloy steel for high hardness and anti-deformation performance. High-density waterproof rubber gaskets are installed at door seams to achieve full protection against water, moisture and theft.

details.heading: 5. Main Applications
items: International Sea Freight Export : Ideal for light bulky cargo such as garments, home textiles, daily necessities and toys, as well as over-height goods including furniture, home appliances and building materials. It provides larger cargo space and higher cost performance than standard 40ft general containers.

Multimodal Combined Transportation : Applicable for seamless connection among truck, ocean vessel and China-Europe railway freight. No cargo reloading or unpacking is required during transit, realizing one-stop door-to-door logistics services.

Temporary Warehouse Storage : The sealed container can be used as outdoor temporary warehouses in ports, factories and yards, protecting stored goods from sunlight, rain and other bad weather all year round.

Compliant Domestic Road Transportation : Its overall height complies with national road height limits for inland trucks, with no over-height risks during domestic land transportation and smooth cross-country delivery.
